title: Evidence Gap Report
goal: Produce a report that honestly separates what is proven, plausible, not yet tested, or contradicted.
scope: Defensive evidence completeness reporting without scans or finding mutation.
generation_reason: Customer reports and operator review need an explicit distinction between confirmed evidence, suspected paths, untested areas, and contradicted claims.

constraints.active_task_gate: Do not implement until this package is the single active task in NEXT_TASK.md.
constraints.scope_creep_guard: Implement defensive evidence completeness reporting. Do not run scans or change findings.

success_criteria: Report separates confirmed, suspected, untested, and contradicted evidence states.
Maps each claim to evidence references.
Highlights unsupported claims that must not appear in customer report.

acceptance_criteria: Evidence gap report separates confirmed, suspected, untested, and contradicted states.
Every claim maps to evidence references or is marked unsupported.
Unsupported claims are highlighted as excluded from customer-facing report prose.

after_completion: Promote exactly one next task into NEXT_TASK.md.
